  <script type="module">
    import * as THREE from "https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/0.160.0/three.module.min.js";

    const app = document.getElementById("app");
    const shelfButton = document.getElementById("shelfButton");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("resetButton");

    // Renderer
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
      antialias: true,
      powerPreference: "high-performance"
    });

    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
    renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
    renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
    renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
    renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.08;
    app.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    // Scene
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xd8d4ca);
    scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xd8d4ca, 11, 24);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
      38,
      window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
      0.1,
      100
    );

    const cameraTarget = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1.55, 0);
    const orbit = {
      radius: 7.6,
      theta: 0.68,
      phi: 1.16
    };

    function updateCamera() {
      const sinPhi = Math.sin(orbit.phi);
      camera.position.set(
        cameraTarget.x + orbit.radius * sinPhi * Math.sin(orbit.theta),
        cameraTarget.y + orbit.radius * Math.cos(orbit.phi),
        cameraTarget.z + orbit.radius * sinPhi * Math.cos(orbit.theta)
      );
      camera.lookAt(cameraTarget);
    }

    updateCamera();

    // Lighting
    const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8ec, 0x665f55, 1.8);
    scene.add(hemisphere);

    const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3dc, 3.2);
    keyLight.position.set(4.5, 7, 5.5);
    keyLight.castShadow = true;
    keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048);
    keyLight.shadow.camera.left = -5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.right = 5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.top = 6;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
    keyLight.shadow.camera.far = 18;
    keyLight.shadow.bias = -0.0004;
    keyLight.shadow.normalBias = 0.025;
    scene.add(keyLight);

    const fillLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xdce8ef, 1.1);
    fillLight.position.set(-4, 3, 2);
    scene.add(fillLight);

    // Procedural wood texture
    function createWoodTexture() {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
      canvas.width = 512;
      canvas.height = 512;
      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

      const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 512, 512);
      gradient.addColorStop(0, "#b87943");
      gradient.addColorStop(0.45, "#a96836");
      gradient.addColorStop(1, "#c1844d");
      ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 512, 512);

      let seed = 8137;
      const random = () => {
        seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647;
        return (seed - 1) / 2147483646;
      };

      for (let i = 0; i < 210; i++) {
        const y = random() * 512;
        const amplitude = 1 + random() * 5;
        const frequency = 0.008 + random() * 0.025;
        const phase = random() * Math.PI * 2;

        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let x = 0; x <= 512; x += 8) {
          const wave =
            Math.sin(x * frequency + phase) * amplitude +
            Math.sin(x * frequency * 0.43 + phase) * amplitude * 0.45;
          if (x === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y + wave);
          else ctx.lineTo(x, y + wave);
        }

        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(73, 37, 15, ${0.035 + random() * 0.09})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.5 + random() * 1.7;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
        const x = random() * 512;
        const y = random() * 512;
        const radiusX = 8 + random() * 25;
        const radiusY = 2 + random() * 7;

        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(x, y, radiusX, radiusY, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(68, 34, 14, 0.12)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
        ctx.stroke();
      }

      const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
      texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
      texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
      texture.anisotropy = renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy();
      return texture;
    }

    const woodTexture = createWoodTexture();

    const materials = {
      wood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: woodTexture,
        color: 0xffffff,
        roughness: 0.68,
        metalness: 0.02
      }),
      darkWood: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        map: woodTexture,
        color: 0x986038,
        roughness: 0.72
      }),
      metal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x465050,
        roughness: 0.3,
        metalness: 0.82
      }),
      darkMetal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x252b2b,
        roughness: 0.4,
        metalness: 0.75
      }),
      rubber: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0x242321,
        roughness: 0.9,
        metalness: 0
      }),
      floor: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
        color: 0xd4d0c6,
        roughness: 0.94,
        metalness: 0
      })
    };

    const rack = new THREE.Group();
    scene.add(rack);

    function addBox(parent, size, position, material, castShadow = true) {
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(size.x, size.y, size.z),
        material
      );
      mesh.position.copy(position);
      mesh.castShadow = castShadow;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    function addBeam(parent, start, end, width, thickness, material) {
      const direction = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(end, start);
      const length = direction.length();
      const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, length, thickness),
        material
      );

      mesh.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
      mesh.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
        direction.normalize()
      );
      mesh.castShadow = true;
      mesh.receiveShadow = true;
      parent.add(mesh);
      return mesh;
    }

    // Two A-frame side supports, each made from flat wooden slats
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const x = side * 2.18;

      const leftFoot = new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.04, -0.92);
      const leftTop = new THREE.Vector3(x, 3.05, -0.17);
      const rightFoot = new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.04, 0.92);
      const rightTop = new THREE.Vector3(x, 3.05, 0.17);

      addBeam(
        rack,
        leftFoot,
        leftTop,
        0.24,
        0.12,
        materials.wood
      );
      addBeam(
        rack,
        rightFoot,
        rightTop,
        0.24,
        0.12,
        materials.wood
      );

      addBeam(
        rack,
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 3.05, -0.92),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 3.05, 0.92),
        0.24,
        0.13,
        materials.wood
      );

      // Rubber feet
      for (const foot of [leftFoot, rightFoot]) {
        addBox(
          rack,
          new THREE.Vector3(0.3, 0.12, 0.24),
          new THREE.Vector3(foot.x, 0.04, foot.z),
          materials.rubber
        );
      }
    }

    // Three horizontal drying rails
    const railHeights = [2.55, 1.85, 1.18];

    function createRoundedRail() {
      const geometry = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.055, 4.05, 6, 14);
      const rail = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, materials.wood);
      rail.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      rail.castShadow = true;
      rail.receiveShadow = true;
      return rail;
    }

    function createNotch(x, y) {
      const points = [
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.06, -0.035),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.135, -0.035),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.135, 0.035),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, y + 0.06, 0.035)
      ];

      const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points, true, "centripetal");
      const notch = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, 12, 0.014, 6, true),
        materials.metal
      );
      notch.castShadow = true;
      return notch;
    }

    railHeights.forEach((height) => {
      const rail = createRoundedRail();
      rail.position.y = height;
      rack.add(rail);

      // Small metal hanging notches along the top of each rail
      for (const x of [-1.65, -0.88, -0.11, 0.66, 1.44]) {
        rack.add(createNotch(x, height));
      }

      // Metal brackets connecting each rail to the A-frame tops
      for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
        const bracketX = side * 2.04;
        const bracketBottom = height;
        const bracketTop = 3.05;

        addBox(
          rack,
          new THREE.Vector3(0.11, bracketTop - bracketBottom, 0.17),
          new THREE.Vector3(bracketX, (bracketTop + bracketBottom) / 2, 0),
          materials.metal
        );

        const bolt = new THREE.Mesh(
          new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.027, 0.027, 0.055, 16),
          materials.darkMetal
        );
        bolt.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
        bolt.position.set(bracketX + side * 0.075, height, 0);
        bolt.castShadow = true;
        rack.add(bolt);
      }
    });

    // Lower hinged shelf
    const shelfGroup = new THREE.Group();
    shelfGroup.position.set(0, 0.8, -0.88);
    rack.add(shelfGroup);

    // Five flat wooden shelf slats
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      addBox(
        shelfGroup,
        new THREE.Vector3(3.55, 0.08, 0.16),
        new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0.18 + i * 0.3),
        materials.wood
      );
    }

    // Shelf perimeter and underside
    for (const x of [-1.72, 1.72]) {
      addBox(
        shelfGroup,
        new THREE.Vector3(0.1, 0.18, 1.45),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, -0.12, 0.72),
        materials.darkWood
      );
    }

    addBox(
      shelfGroup,
      new THREE.Vector3(3.45, 0.1, 0.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.17, 0.72),
      materials.darkWood
    );

    // Short support arms from the shelf to the A-frames
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      addBeam(
        shelfGroup,
        new THREE.Vector3(side * 1.7, -0.12, -0.7),
        new THREE.Vector3(side * 2.05, -0.12, -0.92),
        0.11,
        0.09,
        materials.metal
      );
    }

    // Hinge plates, pins, washers, and dark hole details
    function createHinge(side) {
      const x = side * 1.78;
      const outerSign = Math.sign(side);

      addBox(
        rack,
        new THREE.Vector3(0.055, 0.3, 0.18),
        new THREE.Vector3(x, 0.8, -0.88),
        materials.metal
      );

      const pin = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.034, 0.034, 0.36, 18),
        materials.darkMetal
      );
      pin.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      pin.position.set(x, 0.8, -0.88);
      pin.castShadow = true;
      rack.add(pin);

      // Outer washer
      const washer = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.052, 0.012, 8, 20),
        materials.metal
      );
      washer.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
      washer.position.set(x + outerSign * 0.185, 0.8, -0.88);
      washer.castShadow = true;
      rack.add(washer);

      // Dark circular detail around the pin
      const hole = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.052, 20),
        materials.darkMetal
      );
      hole.rotation.y = Math.PI / 2;
      hole.position.set(x + outerSign * 0.032, 0.8, -0.88);
      rack.add(hole);

      // Matching pin on the opposite end
      const oppositePin = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.034, 0.034, 0.36, 18),
        materials.darkMetal
      );
      oppositePin.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      oppositePin.position.set(x - side * 0.18, 0.8, -0.88);
      oppositePin.castShadow = true;
      rack.add(oppositePin);
    }

    createHinge(-1);
    createHinge(1);

    // Shelf pins move with the shelf but remain aligned with the fixed pins
    for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
      const movingPin = new THREE.Mesh(
        new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.038, 0.038, 0.38, 18),
        materials.darkMetal
      );
      movingPin.rotation.z = Math.PI / 2;
      movingPin.position.set(side * 1.78, 0, 0);
      movingPin.castShadow = true;
      shelfGroup.add(movingPin);
    }

    // Floor
    const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
      new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 30),
      materials.floor
    );
    floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
    floor.position.y = -0.16;
    floor.receiveShadow = true;
    scene.add(floor);

    // Direct camera controls, without external controls modules
    let dragging = false;
    let lastX = 0;
    let lastY = 0;
